summary: Route shopping-list deletion through the verified protobuf operation and confirm read-after-write absence.
reason: A live disposable protocol probe showed that the generic JSON POST to /data/shopping-lists/update can return HTTP 200 without deleting a list. Preserve the verified remove-shopping-list protobuf handler, fail when read-back still finds the list, and remove only the verified list-scoped rows from the local cache.
validated_outcome: Added request-construction coverage for the remove-shopping-list protobuf operation, live-list lookup and read-after-write verification coverage, and transactional local-cache cleanup coverage. Focused AnyList tests and go test ./... pass; no production AnyList data was mutated during validation.
